_doc: 5 Format Family độc lập về Medium + Assembly + Ngôi kể (POV) — xoay vòng cứng để 2 video liền nhau KHÔNG bao giờ mang cùng 1 khuôn hình ảnh hay kiểu kịch bản.

evidence_board_doc.name: Hồ sơ điều tra bảng đen 1 cú máy (Johnny Harris · LEMMiNO)
evidence_board_doc.pov: Investigative micro-documentary grounded in a real date, place, event, or incident. Tell it as a tense factual reconstruction with physical evidence, circled records, and red-string causality — NEVER as a generic '21 studies show' slideshow.
evidence_board_doc.visual_grammar: ONE continuous camera flying across a matte black evidence board (`engines/board/`): `DOC_FOCUS` (circled report lines), `NUMBER_CARD` / `COUNTER`, `REVEAL_PHOTO` (pinned 3D/Flow polaroids), `STAMP`, `CONNECT` (red yarn string cause→effect), `THESIS` (red cross-out twist), ending with `NETWORK_REVEAL` pulling back over the entire investigation wall.
evidence_board_doc.forbidden_habits: Do NOT use `cuts` infographic widgets (`hero_stat`, `xray_cutaway`, `fact:flip`). Every shot lives on the shared board via `beat_recipe` + `board`.

cinema_3d_film.name: Phim ngắn 3D vật lý 100% không slide 2D (Fern · Zack D. Films)
cinema_3d_film.pov: Pure visual cinema — narrate a physical event or simulation in real time with clinical, deadpan clarity while 3D actors and physics carry 100% of the story.
cinema_3d_film.visual_grammar: 100% `three/stage` shots with continuous spatial staging, Rapier physics or acting creatures/mannequins, volumetric lighting, and ≥ 3 distinct cinematic camera angles (`ecu_macro`, `low_hero`, `tracking_low`, `over_shoulder`, `dolly_zoom`) connected by `iris_match` / `whip_match` + `seamless_loop`.
cinema_3d_film.forbidden_habits: ZERO 2D infographic slides (`dossier`, `meter`, `compare`, `fact:flip`). Show everything physically in 3D space.

editorial_infographic.name: Giải mã cơ chế biên tập cao cấp (Vox · Cleo Abram)
editorial_infographic.pov: Sharp analytical explainer built on a paradox, But/Therefore tension chain, mid-video pattern interrupt (`tape_stop` / `iris_match`), and `seamless_loop`.
editorial_infographic.visual_grammar: Mix `dossier`, `xray_cutaway`, `hero_stat`, `story_hud`, and varied 3D `stage` shots with `iris_match`, `whip_match`, and `tape_stop`.
editorial_infographic.forbidden_habits: Avoid repeating the same 3-beat opener across consecutive videos; max 2 consecutive flat cards.

infinite_zoom_journey.name: Cú máy zoom vô tận 1-shot góc nhìn thứ 2 (Kurzgesagt · Ordinary Folk)
infinite_zoom_journey.pov: Immersive second-person sensory journey ('Imagine you shrink down…' / 'Step inside…') following ONE hero traveller continuously from macro scale down to microscopic/molecular reality.
infinite_zoom_journey.visual_grammar: Continuous HTML spine (`dive`, `push_through`, `truck_parallax`) using `scale` (logarithmic zoom), depth-layered `scene` shots (`z` + `camera`), and `timeline`.
infinite_zoom_journey.forbidden_habits: Do NOT break immersion with static report cards or `fact:flip`; keep ONE continuous spatial journey.

fast_tech_autopsy.name: Giải phẫu Tech/AI nhịp sắc bén (Fireship · ByteByteGo)
fast_tech_autopsy.pov: Crisp, witty, high-signal engineering breakdown of an AI model, algorithm, protocol, or developer bottleneck — zero fluff, dry wit, concrete numbers and system flows.
fast_tech_autopsy.visual_grammar: Architectural system flow (`process`, `split` live throughput comparison, `xray_cutaway` packet/tensor flow, 3D `server`/`chip`/`laptop`/`bug` props) with sharp `tape_stop` & `whip_match` cuts.
fast_tech_autopsy.forbidden_habits: No slow biological metaphors or generic inspirational closing lines.
